entries.zh: 叩见：低头俯身行礼以示敬意（谒见尊长时的叩头礼）；亦指整个身体前倾的鞠躬行礼。
entries.en: to bow the head and whole body in sign of reverence; to pay a respectful visit with a bow

entries.zh: 叩拜：低头行礼、叩拜（对神明或尊长之礼拜）。
entries.en: to bow the head in obeisance; to worship by bowing

entries.zh: 俯：低头（有所俯视或俯就）。
entries.en: to lower the head; to bend down toward something

entries.zh: 俯仰：低头而看（俯视）；字面兼含俯首与仰视之意。
entries.en: to lower the head and look; lit. bow and look up (look about)

entries.zh: 叩谢：向尊长低头行礼致谢（叩头道谢）。
entries.en: to bow before a superior in thanks; to thank with a respectful bow

entries.zh: 顿：顿首，头触地以示敬礼（叩头至地）。
entries.en: to knock the head to the ground in reverence; to kowtow

entries.zh: 顿首拜：顿首叩拜，头俯至地面以行敬礼。
entries.en: to kowtow with the head to the ground in reverence; prostration of the head

entries.zh: 踩倒：被石头等绊倒、踩到而跌倒。
entries.en: to stumble over a stone and fall; to trip and fall
entries.notes: 汉字作「採」，[疑] 应为「踩」；西语 baxarse（跌倒）与 chây tò 对音互证，取踩倒义。

entries.zh: 和息：息讼和好，平息争端（和解）。
entries.en: to settle a quarrel; to make peace and cease litigation

entries.zh: 放下：放下、放开（西语语境：低头并放开孩子们让他们去吃饭）。
entries.en: to put down; to let go / release (as letting children go to eat)

entries.zh: 横：横垂、下垂（西语例指黑色披风等垂挂之物下端低垂）。
entries.en: to hang down across; drooping of a hanging cloth (as a black cloak)
entries.notes: 西语条文语义晦涩（baxarla boca la colgadura），依汉字「横」与 hûã 对音取横垂义，垂挂解为推断。

entries.zh: 扳落来：把树枝等拉低、扳下来。
entries.en: to pull/bend down (as a branch of a tree)
entries.notes: 汉字「枋」[疑] 应为「扳」；西语 baxarlo ut rama del árbol（如树枝般压低）与 pâng-lò-lâi 对音互证。

entries.zh: 扯落来：用手拉扯下来（边托扶边拉下）。
entries.en: to pull down with the hand, supporting it as one pulls
entries.notes: 汉字「撦」[疑] 应为「撦/扯」；闽南 chê 落来 与西语 baxar sustentándolo 互证为拉下义。

entries.zh: 落梢：（骑马）下鞍于险处，于难行之处下来。
entries.en: to dismount (from the saddle) at a difficult passage
entries.notes: 「梢/稍」存疑且 T99 污损；西语 baxarse de la silla en el mal passo（下鞍于险径）仅可据以推断为下鞍义。

entries.zh: 下手：伸手、着手去做某事。
entries.en: to put one's hand to something; to set about a task

entries.zh: 减多了：价钱减低了、降价（减得多了）。
entries.en: the price has come down; to lower the price

entries.zh: 下：低下、在下（位置与方向的下）。
entries.en: low; below, down
entries.notes: M 栏 Hē uom. 之 uom 为残句或夹注，依汉字「下」与 R 栏 hiā 取低下/在下义。

entries.zh: 低：低（就自然与道德意义上而言低；延伸指银钱成色不足，如低银）。
entries.en: low in a natural and moral sense; hence debased in quality (as base silver)
entries.notes: 西语条含 quilates ue plata（成色不及银）之延伸义，M 栏 Tap. 为缩写或残字，据语义并列附后。

entries.zh: 卑：卑下（自然与道德意义上的低微）。
entries.en: low, humble; base in a natural and moral sense

entries.zh: 卑贱：卑贱之人，人格低贱者。
entries.en: base, vile; a man of low and vile condition

entries.zh: 卑下：卑贱可鄙之人（西语注：即所谓 asial，言语粗鄙、举止猥琐者）。
entries.en: base and despicable; a vile, contemptible fellow who speaks meanly (so-called asial)
entries.notes: 西语条文后段含混（asial 释义不详），M 栏杂注有 T99 污损；据卑贱+鄙俗之人推断，存疑。
